title: Brand mark · Accredited Program mark translations & bilingual versions
slide_intent: Teach designers to preserve recognition across translations while allowing two languages to identify a program together.
strategic_value: Repeated typographic weight and relative position can connect localized wordmarks to the same international identity.
demonstration: Four translated logotypes appear in the upper comparison. Two Canadian bilingual examples below compare a horizontal two-line arrangement and a centered arrangement.
practical_value: Use the approved translated artwork, preserve its scale relative to the symbol and outline the type when distributing master files.
